notes.subject: עד שוא
notes.rationale: YLT olsem 'answer ... a false testimony' — ana i min 'autim tok'; KJV 'bear false witness'.

notes.subject: waitman
notes.rationale: ed i min man i tok olsem waitman long kot; tok Tok Pisin bilong kot.

notes.subject: ⟨em⟩
notes.rationale: Tok Pisin i laikim objekt; Hebri i no gat pronoun.

notes.subject: Yisrael
notes.rationale: Lo i tok stret long man bilong Yisrael.

translation: Na yu no ken givim tok nogut long ⟨em⟩ olsem waitman — tok gutpela i gat nogut — long wantok bilong yu.
